text:
maria: Quick check — wiring review for the Datadog tile UX/embed snippets. HW partners need tiny HTML/iframe snippets for private/air-gapped installs. Can design + eng-obs sync on constraints?

sam: I can prep a sample widget snippet. Need the OTLP mapping doc and max payload size. What's the firmware limit on the edge boxes? @alex

alex: Edge boxes cap upload ~128KB per POST, jittered every 10s, no websockets. No external CDNs allowed for some SI installs. We'll also need minimal RAM/CPU footprint for the shim.

maria: Noted. Product ask: ship both dashboard JSON + a small embeddable card (150x90) and an iframe fallback. @jason_dd can Datadog export a compact tile that fits those dims?

jason_dd: Yes — we can export a compact tile and provide dashboard JSON + a lightweight embed JS shim. ETA end of week. Quick Q: auth via signed cookie or token header for private installs?

denise: Token header preferred for private installs (rotatable). Also we need an example collector config for offline installs and a short install-runbook. Sam, can you own the collector snippet?

sam: On it. Draft example below (secrets redacted):

```yaml
otlp:
  endpoint: "https://collector.redwood.local:4318/v1/traces"
  headers:
    dd-api-key: "REDACTED"
  max_payload_kb: 120
```

Will also produce a minified embed JS (~6KB).

alex: Can you produce a non-JS fallback (iframe) for air-gapped installs? Some SI teams block inline scripts entirely.

jason_dd: We can supply an iframe + postMessage handshake pattern. We'll add a CORS/offline guidance doc. Pinged docs team to create a short section.

denise: Launch constraints: 2-week private beta with 3 SI partners starting Mon 2026-04-06. Marketing embargo through Mon 2026-04-20. Can we get final assets by 2026-04-02? @maria

maria: Yes — target date 2026-04-02 for final deliverables. I'll consolidate a checklist. Quick asks list: (1) sample dashboard JSON (2) embed JS + iframe fallback (3) collector YAML (4) install-runbook snippet (5) brief security note for SI legal. Anyone else?

opsbot: deploy-bot: Scheduled staging push for dd-tile assets on 2026-03-29 03:00 UTC

jason_dd: :thumbsup: I'll upload draft dashboard JSON to the shared folder and tag you. Will include a short 'privacy for on-prem' blurb.

sam: I'll post a minimized JS snippet + an iframe example this afternoon. Adding CI tests to exercise a 128KB payload to the collector and a checklist step to verify no external CDN calls.

maria: :partyparrot: great — I'll create the public checklist doc and share in #partnerships later today.
